verdict_basis: The exact supplied summary has no identified material contradiction or important omission for the supplied Scythe base/core multiplayer rules. All material numeric scoring diagrams and action/faction procedures reviewed agree with the authoritative inputs.

scope.included: Base/core multiplayer for 2-5 players as described by the supplied English 32-page source PDF, including core faction abilities, optional action/benefit choices, all six structure scoring tiles and material edge cases.
excluded: Explicitly optional variants, including Delay of Game
Later errata or rules not contained in the three supplied inputs
scope.materiality_standard: A contradiction or omission is material if it can reasonably change legal play, costs, quantities, destinations, timing, control, combat outcome, achievement eligibility, final scoring or winner determination in the scoped game.

method: Read the exact full supplied summary and the entire supplied page-delimited extracted source text (pages 1-32); compared summary claims against the complete rule flow and endgame rules rather than selected passages only.

Used the supplied PDF directly with pypdf to inspect page count, embedded diagram images and source graphics. Displayed extracted original PDF images as labelled contact sheets in the authorized assets directory; no externally sourced images or rule data were used.

Visually checked board/starting mat information, all top/bottom action and production/recruit icon quantities needed for claims, the lake/tunnel movement example, Riverwalk reference, popularity scoring graphic, and each of the six structure-bonus tile graphics.

Separated material gameplay omissions from packing-list details, strategy suggestions, historical text and excluded optional content. Read all source sections, including highlighted rules, to cross-check exceptions and destinations.
Computed SHA256 over each exact input and rechecked input integrity at report creation. Source references are printed/PDF pages, which coincide for this 32-page PDF.

visual_verification.method: Original embedded source images extracted with pypdf and displayed via view_image; this avoids dependence on OCR for numeric diagrams. Contact sheets preserve original diagrams with only scaling and labels.

key_confirmed_values.production: Two base selected territories; upgradeable third selection; visible power/popularity/coin cost symbols; per-worker output from source text; Mill adds separate producing territory and own output.

important_omission_assessment.assessment: The summary covers all core multiplayer procedures needed to set up, take and pay actions, move/transport units, resolve enemy entry and combat, use factions, resolve encounters and Factory visits, place stars, stop play, score every category and break ties.

nonmaterial_omissions_considered.subject: Full physical inventory and combat-card distribution
nonmaterial_omissions_considered.reason: The summary retains gameplay-limiting faction-piece counts and relies on printed card values. Inventory counts of general supply components and combat-card probability distribution are not necessary to resolve legal play; resource supply is explicitly unlimited.

nonmaterial_omissions_considered.subject: Individual mat-specific starting values and bottom costs/coin rewards; each upgradeable benefit magnitude
nonmaterial_omissions_considered.reason: The supplied rules also direct players to their dealt mats. The summary explicitly gives the exposed-box method and default top actions, and correctly delegates changing/variable values to the actual mat.

nonmaterial_omissions_considered.subject: Quick-start suggestions, lore, achievement-sheet commemorations, suggested sample scoring and strategy notes
nonmaterial_omissions_considered.reason: These are teaching aids, strategy, theme or recordkeeping rather than material core rules.

source_interpretation_notes.note: The p. 2 quick reference loosely says objectives may be completed at any time; the summary follows the more specific full p. 26 rule restricting reveal to the player’s own turn before or after a top/bottom action.
The p. 28 example calls the upper scoring level 13-17 while explicitly including popularity 18. The p. 29 graphic shows the same top rate through 18, so the summary’s 13-18 row is supported.

The p. 2 quick reference uses a broad units/structures tiebreak shorthand; p. 29 specifically lists workers, mechs and structures. The summary correctly follows that detailed list and excludes the character.

limitations: Verdict is limited to the exact hashed supplied summary and supplied edition of the source; it does not certify later published clarifications, balance restrictions or errata.

The supplied source reproduces representative mats and cards, not every physical card/mat combination. The audit verifies the summary’s instruction to follow printed/exposed values rather than attempting to reconstruct unspecified physical components.

A full-page PDF rasterizer was unavailable in the shell environment. Relevant original embedded graphics were extracted directly from the supplied PDF and visually inspected instead; all six required tile graphics and the material mat/recruit/production/scoring graphics were accessible.
PASS means no material contradiction or important omission was identified after the complete scoped review; it is not a claim that all nonessential source text has been reproduced.
